product_workflow.baseline: A separately implemented user-facing text/multimodal retrieval workflow, not B renamed.
capability_differences: Baseline retrieves original frozen text/table chunks, has no graph traversal and no deterministic calculator.
Both use the same text model; baseline uses a separate vision observation when reference/query images are present.
Numeric and semantic baseline answers require independent review, not tool receipt scoring.

expected_policy: Explicit source values/arithmetic authored independently of calculator execution; human source review required. Runtime TaskSpec and model self-judgments are never gold.
limits: 12 post-implementation exploratory cases; no blind or independent accuracy claim.
PM-09 and PM-10 reuse previously evaluated capture families; all 35 prior crops are grouped as development.
Question and expected-goal text remain unchanged; PM-09 old missing-image wording records v1 history. Input availability is recorded in input_audit.json.
Draft legacy labels and source metadata are not human approvals and are never passed to the Agent.
Original v1 and legacy60 artifacts remain unchanged; the nine old missing-image interactions are not all completed by this version.
Knowledge, rules, semantic gold and answer outcomes each still require the appropriate independent review.
Product baseline remains exploratory; formal product comparison protocol not approved.

visual_policy.thresholds: Calibrate on development only, freeze before held-out scoring.
